messages:
emma: Heads-up everyone: billing timing + credit term refresh going live next month. Please review. :loudspeaker:

luis: summary?

emma: TL;DR:
- Monthly invoice cutoff moves to 06:00 UTC on the 1st of each month (was last-day 23:59 UTC).
- New trial/free credits issued after the effective date expire after 120 days (was 180). Existing credits are grandfathered.
- Overage grace: new Hosted accounts get a 48-hour soft grace for quota overages before billing; existing accounts unchanged unless they opt in.

billing-bot: Note: rate limits (rps/token throughput) are unchanged. Billing engine flag: `overage_grace_hours=48` for new_accounts only.

nina: why shorten credit windows to 120? customers will ask.

emma: two reasons: clean forecasting (reduce long-tail liabilities) and align promo schedule. We kept grandfathering to avoid surprising current users. CS and Growth reviewed.

luis: will Dedicated/reserved customers be affected?

emma: No contract terms for Dedicated change. This is for standard Hosted billing flows only. Reserved capacity invoices remain on their contract-specified dates.

product-bot: Docs task created: `docs/billing/credit-term-2026-11` assigned to nina.

nina: need a customer notice draft.

emma: Draft sample copy below (CS will edit):

```
Subject: Upcoming change to Redwood billing timing and trial credit terms
Hi <Customer>,
Wewanted to let you know that starting <DATE> we will shift our monthly invoice cutoff to 06:00 UTC on the 1st of each month. In addition, new trial credits issued after <DATE> will expire after 120 days. Existing credits issued before <DATE> will keep their original expiry.
No action is required from you; billing and usage will continue to appear in the Console. If you have questions, contact support@redwood.example.com.
```

luis: action items?

emma: Action owners:
- CS: finalize customer email & templates (owner: luis).
- Docs: update billing pages & FAQ (owner: nina).
- Billing eng: implement cutoff shift and grace flag; run e2e tests (owner: emma).
- Finance: update forecasting model & reconciliation note (owner: finance-team).

billing-bot: Reminder scheduled: rollout checklist 7 days before effective date.

emma: Thanks all. I'll post this to the company announcements page and CS workspace. Ping me for escalation. :thumbsup:
